INFLUENCER ENDORSEMENT AGREEMENT

This Influencer Endorsement Agreement (this "Agreement") is made as of May 20, 2026 between Vantage Coffee Roasters, Inc., a Washington corporation ("Brand"), and Rosalind Achebe-Karlsson, an individual residing in Providence, Rhode Island ("Influencer").

1. SERVICES

1.1 Deliverables. Influencer shall create and publish the content described on Exhibit A (the "Content"): three (3) in-feed video posts and six (6) story frames on Influencer's Instagram account, and two (2) short-form videos on Influencer's TikTok account, on the schedule stated on Exhibit A.

1.2 Approval. Influencer shall submit each piece of Content to Brand at least five (5) business days before the scheduled publication date. Brand may request changes for accuracy, legal compliance, or brand-safety reasons, and Influencer shall make those changes. Brand may not require Influencer to state an opinion Influencer does not hold.

1.3 Honest Opinion. Influencer represents that Influencer has used the products and that every statement in the Content reflects Influencer's honest opinions, findings, beliefs, and experience, as 16 C.F.R. Part 255 requires.

2. DISCLOSURE OF THE MATERIAL CONNECTION

2.1 Required Disclosure. Influencer shall clearly and conspicuously disclose the material connection with Brand in each piece of Content, in accordance with the FTC's Guides Concerning the Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising, 16 C.F.R. Part 255, and the FTC's Endorsement Guides FAQs.

2.2 Form of Disclosure. The disclosure shall appear in the content itself, unavoidable without clicking "more", in the same language as the Content, and, for video, both in the audio and superimposed on the screen for the duration of any endorsement. Influencer shall use "#ad" or "Paid partnership with Vantage" and shall not rely on a platform's built-in tool alone. Influencer shall not bury the disclosure among other hashtags.

2.3 No Deceptive Claims. Influencer shall not make any claim about the products that Brand has not substantiated in writing, shall not represent any health benefit, and shall not compare the products to a competitor's without Brand's written approval.

3. COMPENSATION

3.1 Fee. Brand shall pay Influencer $18,000, payable one-half within ten (10) days after execution and one-half within thirty (30) days after the last piece of Content is published and accepted.

3.2 Product. Brand shall provide products with a retail value of approximately $600, which Influencer may keep and which are part of the consideration for this Agreement.

3.3 Affiliate Commission. Brand shall pay Influencer eight percent (8%) of net revenue from orders placed through Influencer's unique tracking link during the Term, reported monthly and paid within thirty (30) days after each month end.

3.4 Taxes. Influencer is an independent contractor and is responsible for all taxes on the compensation. Brand shall issue a Form 1099 as required.

4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND USAGE

4.1 Ownership of the Content. Influencer owns the Content, subject to the licence in Section 4.2.

4.2 Licence to Brand. Influencer grants Brand a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence to reproduce, distribute, display, and create derivative works of the Content, and to use Influencer's name, likeness, voice, and handle in connection with it, on Brand's owned channels for eighteen (18) months after publication, and in paid media for six (6) months after publication. Any use beyond those windows or channels requires Influencer's written consent and additional compensation to be agreed.

4.3 Third-Party Rights. Influencer shall clear all third-party rights in the Content, including music, and shall not include any third-party trademark without Brand's approval.

4.4 Brand Marks. Brand grants Influencer a non-exclusive licence to use Brand's marks solely as necessary to create and publish the Content, in the form Brand specifies. All goodwill inures to Brand.

5. EXCLUSIVITY

5.1 Category Exclusivity. During the Term and for sixty (60) days after it, Influencer shall not create sponsored content for any other roasted-coffee or ready-to-drink-coffee brand. This restriction does not apply to organic, unpaid mentions.

6. COMPLIANCE AND CONDUCT

6.1 Platform Rules. Influencer shall comply with the terms of service and branded-content policies of each platform, and shall use each platform's paid-partnership tool in addition to the disclosure required by Section 2.

6.2 Morals. Brand may terminate this Agreement immediately, and withhold any unpaid compensation for Content not yet published, if Influencer engages in conduct that is criminal, or that is reasonably likely to bring Brand into public disrepute, as Brand reasonably determines after giving Influencer an opportunity to respond.

6.3 Influencer Morals Protection. Influencer may terminate this Agreement immediately if Brand engages in conduct that is criminal or that is reasonably likely to bring Influencer into public disrepute, and Brand shall pay for Content already published.

7. TERM AND TERMINATION

7.1 Term. This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and continues until ninety (90) days after the last piece of Content is published, unless terminated earlier (the "Term").

7.2 Termination for Cause. Either party may terminate on written notice if the other materially breaches and fails to cure within ten (10) business days.

7.3 Effect of Termination. On termination, Influencer shall be paid for Content published before termination, the licence in Section 4.2 continues for Content already published, and Influencer shall not remove published Content during the licence period without Brand's consent. Sections 2.1, 4, 8 and 9 survive.

8. INDEMNITY AND LIABILITY

8.1 Influencer Indemnity. Influencer shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Brand against any claim arising out of the Content that Brand did not approve, Influencer's failure to disclose as Section 2 requires, or Influencer's breach of Section 4.3.

8.2 Brand Indemnity. Brand shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Influencer against any claim arising out of the products themselves, out of claims Brand supplied and substantiated, or out of Brand's use of the Content beyond the licence.

8.3 Procedure. The indemnified party shall give prompt written notice, the indemnifying party shall control the defense, and no settlement imposing a non-monetary obligation on the indemnified party may be made without its consent.

8.4 Limitation. Except for the indemnity obligations in this Section 8 and either party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, neither party's aggregate liability shall exceed the total compensation paid under this Agreement, and neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages.

9. GENERAL

9.1 Governing Law; Venue. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Washington. Any action arising out of this Agreement shall be brought in the state or federal courts located in King County, Washington.

9.2 Independent Contractor. Influencer is an independent contractor and not an employee, partner, or agent of Brand.

9.3 Assignment. Influencer may not assign this Agreement. Brand may assign it to a successor to substantially all of its business.

9.4 Notices. All notices shall be in writing and delivered by electronic mail with confirmation of receipt to the addresses stated beneath the signatures.

9.5 Entire Agreement; Amendment. This Agreement, with Exhibit A, is the entire agreement between the parties and may be amended only in a writing signed by both.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.

VANTAGE COFFEE ROASTERS, INC.
